text:
Cutter Gauthier is the whole conversation in Anaheim right now, and fairly so. He carried a nine-game goal streak out of the 6-1 win over Calgary, and Daily Faceoff noted he became the first NHLer to record four hat tricks in one month. Over his last ten games he has 22 points against 11.8 expected, with Mikael Granlund (18) and Beckett Sennecke (17) riding along on the same line. That's a heater, and heaters cool.

The record, 11-10-1, is a fair read of the team underneath. The Ducks have scored 85 and allowed 85, they get 49% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) overall and only 46% at five on five, and they've scored about 11 more goals than their chances earned. The top line is a good example: seven goals for, four against, while being outchanced at five on five. The top defense pairs are getting buried, near 37% of the expected goals each.

What worries us more is the net. Ville Husso is at .842 and Lukas Dostal at .832 over their last five starts, both more than four goals worse than expected. Our playoff odds sit at 56%, which is about where a .500 team with a hot scorer and cold goalies belongs. Watch whether the goaltending comes back before Gauthier's shooting does.
